parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set routing-options multicast all-routes.explanation: 配置路由选项以支持所有多播路由。

parameters.name: multicast-option
parameters.explanation: 多播路由选项，all-routes表示支持所有多播路由。

set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from destination-address [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001 term 1 from destination-address 232.1.1.0/24
set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的条件，指定目的地址。

set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet filter ACL-2001.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的动作，接受匹配的流量。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配流量的处理动作，accept表示接受。

set protocols isis level 2 wide-metrics-.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的级别2仅使用宽度量。

parameters.name: metric-type
parameters.explanation: 度量类型，wide-metrics-only表示仅使用宽度量。

set protocols isis interface all.explanation: 配置所有接口参与IS-IS协议。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 接口名称，all表示所有接口。

set protocols isis interface lo0 family.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]
set protocols isis interface lo0 family.command: set protocols isis interface lo0 family inet address 192.168.2.1
set protocols isis interface lo0 family.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的环回接口的IPv4地址。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对级别的操作，disable表示禁用。

set protocols isis interface lo0 passive.command: set protocols isis interface lo0 passive
set protocols isis interface lo0 passive.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的环回接口为被动模式。

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: 接口模式，passive表示被动模式。

set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/0 mod.command: set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/0 mode sparse
set protocols pim interface ge-1/0/0 mod.explanation: 配置PIM协议的接口模式为稀疏模式。

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0 po.command: set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0 po.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的接口为点对点模式。

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: 接口模式，point-to-point表示点对点模式。

set protocols pim interface ge-2/0/0 mod.command: set protocols pim interface ge-2/0/0 mode sparse
set protocols pim interface ge-2/0/0 mod.explanation: 配置PIM协议的接口模式为稀疏模式。

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0 po.command: set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0 point-to-point
set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0 po.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的接口为点对点模式。

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: 接口模式，point-to-point表示点对点模式。

set protocols pim ssm default-group-rang.command: set protocols pim ssm default-group-range ACL-2001
set protocols pim ssm default-group-rang.explanation: 配置PIM SSM的默认组范围。

set protocols pim rp static address 192..template: set protocols pim rp static address [parameter1]
set protocols pim rp static address 192..command: set protocols pim rp static address 192.168.4.1

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.110.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet igmp version [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet igmp version 3

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
